sources.title: Poisoned Pipelines: Malicious AI Model and Skill Repositories
sources.snippet: The platform's model card system and community review processes create a credible appearance of curation, but the fundamental trust model depends on individual contributors acting in good faith — a proposition that threat actors have learned to exploit. The emergence of agentic AI systems has opened a parallel distribution surface.

sources.title: IInkAnalyzer::GetDirtyRegion method (IACom.h) - Win32 apps
sources.snippet: The IInkAnalyzer analyzes ink within its dirty region during a call to IInkAnalyzer::Analyze Method or IInkAnalyzer::BackgroundAnalyze Method. However, the IInkAnalyzer may expand the analysis operation to include neighboring regions.
